# 🏢 Denver Express Warehousing & Cross-Docking / No Limit Trucking LLC

> **Primary Physical Location:** 6030 Washington St, Ste 130, Denver, CO 80216  
> **Facility Profile:** 60,000+ sq ft warehouse, 6 dock-high receiving doors, FDA food-grade ambient storage.  
> **Corporate Synergy:** Asset terminal + regional fleet (No Limit Trucking) + freight brokerage (No Limit Logistics).

---

## 👥 Key Stakeholders & Org Chart

| Name | Role | Location | Strategic Angle |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Craig Bedore** | Dock Operating Principal & Co-Owner | 6030 Washington St (On-site) | Manages daily dock crews, forklift operations, and walk-in reworks. Will be the live tester of the `/dock` tablet interface. |
| **Steve Chapman** | Principal & Executive Co-Owner | Corporate / Denver | Registered owner since 1998. Focuses on asset value, liability reduction, and business profitability. Signs contracts. |
| **Dale Burget** | Principal & Executive Co-Owner | Corporate / Denver | Senior partner. Values reliable infrastructure and low administrative overhead. Signs contracts. |
| **Michael Morelli** | Freight Logistics Coordinator | Denver / Transport | Warm contact via **Elward Systems** manufacturing connection. High trust bridge. |
| **Rick Morelli** | Logistics / Operations | Denver / Transport | Peer connection from Elward Systems panel shipping days. |

---

## 💼 Commercial Opportunity: ReworkFlow™ Buyout

* **Product:** [[ReworkFlow Terminal Platform]]
* **Structure:** **$9,500.00 Asset Purchase** (100% Codebase Ownership, deposited to their GitHub).
* **Payment Terms:** 50% upon signing ($4,750), 50% upon on-site terminal handover and staff training ($4,750).
* **Hardware Options:**
  * **Package A (2-Forklift Starter):** $980.00 (Covers Bay 1 & Bay 2).
  * **Package B (6-Bay Full Facility):** $2,850.00 (Dedicated unit for all 6 bays).
  * **Client Hardware:** $0.00.
* **Support Options:**
  * Yorkstead SLA: $450.00 / month (optional, 30-day cancel).
  * [[Partner Dossier - SpinFlow.ai|SpinFlow Handover]]: Free handover to their web agency to host on `rework.denverexpressco.com`.
* **Territorial Protection:** 15-mile non-compete covenant protecting Denver Express along I-70/I-25 against competitors like [[I-70 & I-25 Freight Corridor Intelligence#Direct Regional Competitors|FreightBox and FMG]].

---

## ⚙️ Operational Pain Points Being Solved

1. **Highway Search Vacuum:** Drivers search Google Maps on I-70 after shifting cargo on Floyd Hill. Denver Express currently has no instant booking, causing drivers to bounce to competitors.
2. **ELD Clock Pressure:** Drivers have <45 minutes before hours-of-service violations. ReworkFlow's 45-minute bay hold solves this immediately.
3. **Broker Comchek Delays:** Upfront transparent estimates let drivers get Comchek / EFS advances authorized before pulling off the highway.
4. **Dock-to-Desk Disconnect:** The front office currently uses paper and foot traffic. `/office` provides real-time Web Audio chimes and live bay status.
5. **Post-Dispatch Chargebacks:** Forklift operators take watermarked GPS/timestamped before/after photos and capture digital driver signatures on the [[Industrial Hardware Specification|HOTWAV R9 Pro]] tablet, creating an immutable PDF evidence certificate and QuickBooks export.

---

* **Live Demo:** [https://rework.yorkstead.com](https://rework.yorkstead.com)

* **Master Brief PDF:** `C:\Users\4twen\Downloads\Denver_Express_ReworkFlow_Master_Brief_Latest.pdf`

  * [[The $9,500 Asset Purchase Strategy]]
  * [[Warm Referral Pitch - Morelli Playbook]]

The manufacturing background at Elward Systems serves as Yorkstead's primary competitive advantage when selling to industrial and logistics companies:

1. **Floor-Level Credibility:** Industrial decision-makers (cross-dock owners, dispatchers, superintendents) routinely dismiss generic tech salespeople. Having managed fabrication shifts, loading cranes, rigging, and freight logistics provides immediate peer respect.
2. **The Morelli Connection:** Michael Morelli and Rick Morelli worked alongside Yorkstead's founder on architectural panel transport, trailer balancing, and driver dispatch.

# 🚜 Industrial Hardware Specification: HOTWAV R9 Pro & RAM Mounts

> Sourced and validated for heavy industrial cross-dock operations at 6030 Washington St.  
> Eliminates fragile consumer iPads and avoids \$3,000 Honeywell/Zebra scanner markups.

---

## 📱 Primary Tablet: HOTWAV R9 Pro 11" Rugged Android 14

* **Price:** \$259.99 – \$289.99 (Amazon Prime)
* **Battery:** **20,080 mAh** monster capacity. Operates 3 to 5 continuous 8-hour shifts without recharging. Eliminates costly forklift DC-to-DC electrical converter wiring.
* **Environmental Rating:** **IP68 / IP69K Waterproof & Dustproof**. Resistant to high-pressure hot-water washdown, reefer melt, diesel exhaust, and freezing warehouse temperatures.
* **Display:** 11-inch 2K FHD+ screen with high-nit sunlight readability and capacitive **glove-touch mode**.
* **Connectivity:** **4G Dual SIM LTE + Dual-Band Wi-Fi**. Guarantees uninterrupted connectivity when forklift operators enter deep inside 53-foot metal dry vans where warehouse Wi-Fi drops.
* **Camera:** 64MP rear inspection camera with LED flash for documenting freight damage.

---

## 🔩 Mounting System: RAM MOUNTS Heavy Duty

* **Roll-Cage Clamp:** **RAM MOUNTS Tough-Claw™ Medium** (`RAP-B-404U`) (\$48.99)
  * Clamps securely onto 1" to 1.6" round, square, or odd-shaped roll-cage overhead guard bars.
  * Installed in 60 seconds with zero drilling or permanent forklift modification.
* **Tablet Cradle:** **RAM MOUNTS X-Grip® Spring-Loaded 12" Cradle** (`RAM-HOL-UN11U`) (\$121.99)
  * Spring-loaded rubber-tipped posts expand and lock around the 11" HOTWAV chassis.
  * Patented rubber ball-and-socket design dampens severe shock vibrations from driving over steel dock levelers and cracked concrete.

---

## 📦 Turnkey Commercial Packages

### Package A: 2-Forklift Starter Bundle — \$980.00 Total
*Recommended for initial rollout; covers Bay 1 & Bay 2 designated rework lanes.*
* 2x HOTWAV R9 Pro 11" Rugged Industrial Work Tablets.
* 2x RAM Tough-Claw Roll-Cage Mounts.
* 2x RAM X-Grip 12" Heavy-Duty Tablet Cradles.
* Delivered, branded with Denver Express kiosk lock, and mounted on-site during staff training.

### Package B: 6-Bay Full Facility Bundle — \$2,850.00 Total
*Complete wall-to-wall coverage for all 6 dock doors or the entire forklift fleet.*
* 6x HOTWAV R9 Pro 11" Rugged Industrial Work Tablets.
* 6x RAM Tough-Claw Roll-Cage Mounts.
* 6x RAM X-Grip 12" Heavy-Duty Tablet Cradles.
* Dedicated tablet per dock door across all 60,000 sq ft. Pre-configured and mounted on-site.

### Client-Provided Hardware Option — \$0.00
* Denver Express procures their own Android tablets; Yorkstead configures the web application URL during on-site training.
* Zero software licensing penalties regardless of device count.

---

title: ReworkFlow Terminal Platform
content:
# ⚡ ReworkFlow™ Terminal Platform

> **Live Production System:** [rework.yorkstead.com](https://rework.yorkstead.com)  
> **Source Code:** [github.com/yorkstead/rework-flow](https://github.com/yorkstead/rework-flow)  
> **Deployment Infrastructure:** Vercel Edge Network, custom domain SSL, React 19 / Next.js 15 App Router.

---

## 🏗️ 4-Stage Operational Architecture

```
[Highway Driver] ──> /maps (Google Maps Simulation)
                         │
                         ▼
                     /reserve (Instant Quote & 45m Bay Hold)
                         │
        ┌────────────────┴────────────────┐
        ▼                                 ▼
   /office (Dispatch Board)          /dock (Forklift Terminal)
   - Real-time Audio Alert           - Glove-friendly Touch UI
   - Live Bay Status (Bays 1-6)      - Timestamped / GPS Camera
   - QuickBooks Invoicing            - Touchscreen Signature Pad
```

### 1. Stage 0: Acquisition (`/maps`)
* **Purpose:** Simulates an emergency Google Maps search for *"pallet rework near me"* on Interstate 70.
* **Feature:** Denver Express listing includes an eye-catching gold **⚡ Reserve Dock Bay & Instant Quote** button, contrasting with competitors who only offer generic telephone numbers.

### 2. Stage 1: Highway Lock (`/reserve`)
* **Purpose:** Driver self-service calculator while pulled over on I-70 or at a truck stop.
* **Functionality:** 
  * Selects damage type (Shifted Pallets, Banding Failure, Port of Entry Overweight Axle).
  * Calculates real-time estimates ($450–$550).
  * Enters Carrier MC/DOT, trailer number, and cell phone.
  * Locks designated bay with an animated **45-minute countdown clock** (matching the legal ELD hours limit).

### 3. Stage 2: Front Desk Alert (`/office`)
* **Purpose:** Continuous operational cockpit for front desk and dispatchers (Steve, Dale, Craig).
* **Audio Alerts:** Uses native browser **Web Audio synthesis** (880Hz / 440Hz harmonic chime) to sound through desktop speakers when a truck reserves. Zero paid audio hardware required.
* **Dispatch Actions:** 1-click status advancement (Reserved ➔ Docked ➔ In Progress ➔ Completed), QuickBooks CSV export.

### 4. Stage 3: Glove-Friendly Forklift Terminal (`/dock`)
* **Purpose:** Mounts on Toyota/Crown forklifts via [[Industrial Hardware Specification|HOTWAV R9 Pro + RAM Mounts]].
* **Touch Optimization:** 48px+ high-contrast buttons designed for thick leather work gloves in cold weather.
* **Evidence Capture:** Dual-camera damage photo capture with automated Denver Express branding, GPS coordinates, and Mountain Time stamp.
* **Driver Sign-Off:** Digital signature canvas directly on the tablet glass.

---

## 💻 Tech Stack & Zero-Lock-In Guarantee

* **Framework:** Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript
* **Styling:** Tailwind CSS (industrial high-contrast slate & amber color scheme)
* **Audio:** Web Audio API (cross-platform, zero dependencies)
* **Icons:** Lucide React

content:
# 🚚 Market Intelligence: The I-70 / I-25 Freight Rework Corridor

## 🏔️ The Physical Geography of Load Shifts

Every week, hundreds of over-the-road (OTR) semi-trucks haul 40,000 to 45,000 lbs of consumer freight eastbound across the Rocky Mountains on Interstate 70:
1. **The Downgrade:** Trucks descend through Eisenhower Tunnel, Vail Pass, and the 6% downgrade of **Floyd Hill into Golden**.
2. **The Damage:** Extreme braking, switchbacks, and sudden deceleration cause pallets of bottled beverages, canned goods, and packaging materials to lean, tip, or burst shrink wrap.
3. **The Rejection:** Receiving distribution centers in Commerce City, Aurora, and Henderson (King Soopers/Kroger, Walmart, Sysco, UNFI) immediately reject trailers with tipped pallets.
4. **The Port of Entry:** Shifting weight puts tractor tandem or trailer axles over legal Colorado DOT bridge limits.

---

## ⏳ The Three Pressures on Stranded Truckers

1. **The ELD Clock:** Drivers have strict Federal Hours of Service limits. Often they have under 45 minutes of legal drive time remaining before forced shutdown.
2. **Broker Authorization Deadlock:** Drivers cannot pay out-of-pocket cash ($400–$700). Brokers require a firm price upfront before issuing an electronic **Comchek** or **EFS** code.
3. **The Phone Tag Void:** Drivers search *"cross dock near me"* on Google Maps, call facilities, and get voicemail or non-committal answers.

---

## 🎯 Direct Regional Competitors (15-Mile Radius)

| Competitor | Location | Distance from 6030 Washington | Threat Profile |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **FreightBox (Cross Dock Denver)** | 5205 Monroe St, Denver | **1.8 miles** | **Direct Primary Threat:** Aggressive SEO for *"Denver Cross Dock"*, 24/7 on-call claims, short distance from I-70/I-25. |
| **FMG Denver** | 40th & Franklin St corridor | ~3.5 miles | Specializes in refrigerated/frozen transload and reefer reworks. |
| **Ambry Inc.** | Commerce City | ~5 miles | Regional warehousing and local distribution. |
| **Adams Logistics** | Commerce City / 56th Ave | ~6 miles | Dry freight transload and contract storage. |

### The 15-Mile Exclusivity Shield
By guaranteeing Denver Express a **15-mile non-compete covenant**, Yorkstead legally promises never to sell or license ReworkFlow to FreightBox, FMG, Ambry, or any competitor at the I-70/I-25 interchange.

---

* [[The $9,500 Asset Purchase Strategy]]

# 💰 Commercial Strategy: The \$9,500 Capital Asset Buyout

> **The Yorkstead Philosophy:** Blue-collar industrial businesses hate monthly software subscriptions ("SaaS rent"). They invest in forklifts, real estate, and racking as balance-sheet capital assets. Software should be treated the same way.

---

## 🎯 The Commercial Offer

* **Total Software Purchase:** **\$9,500.00 (One-Time)**
  * **Payment Terms:** 50% upon signing (\$4,750.00), 50% upon on-site delivery and staff training (\$4,750.00).
* **What is Included:**
  * 100% full source code ownership (deposited to Client's GitHub).
  * **15-Mile Territorial Exclusivity Covenant** along the I-70/I-25 freight interchange.
  * **SpinFlow Handover Architecture** with 1-hour engineering transition session.
  * On-site terminal setup, bay calibration, and staff training at 6030 Washington St.
  * Zero per-user, per-forklift, or per-rework software licensing fees forever.

---

## 🛠️ Add-On Offerings

1. **Hardware Add-On (Optional):**
   * **Package A (2-Bay Starter):** \$980.00 (2x HOTWAV R9 Pro 11" 20,080mAh + 2x RAM Mounts).
   * **Package B (6-Bay Full Facility):** \$2,850.00 (6x HOTWAV R9 Pro 11" + 6x RAM Mounts).
   * **Client Hardware:** \$0.00.
2. **Support & Maintenance SLA (Optional):**
   * **\$450.00 / month** (30-day cancellation notice).
   * Includes uptime monitoring, security patching, priority break-fix, and 4 free dev hours/month.
   * Completely optional if Denver Express chooses to have SpinFlow maintain the app.

---

## 📈 Economic ROI & Payback Math

* **Average Emergency Rework Fee:** \$480 – \$650 per truck.
* **Volume Reality:** Several stranded OTR trucks bounce off Denver Express every week due to phone tag and lack of instant bay reservations.
* **The ROI Equation:** Capturing just **2 additional trucks per week** generates **\$4,160/month in net new revenue (\$49,920 annually)**.
* **Payback Period:** The entire \$9,500 investment pays for itself in less than **58 days**.

---
